newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary MOL unit takes up $50 mln loan-MTI.
newsitem.headline: Hungary MOL unit takes up $50 mln loan-MTI.

text.p: Hungary's Termektarolo Rt, a joint venture of MOL Rt and state-owned Oil and Oil Products Storage Association (KKKSz) took up a $50 million syndicated loan on Wednesday to expand oil storage capacity.
The eight-year syndicated loan, arranged by ABN AMRO Bank will finance the construction of a 315,000 cubic meters oil and white products storage capacity, Hungarian news agency MTI said.
An 1993 law requires KKKSz to increase Hungary's storage capacity of strategic oil reserves from 40 days now to 90 days in 1999. -- Budapest newsroom +36 1 327 4040
